_comment: Source of truth for the in-app 'update available' sheet. Publish a byte-identical copy to https://hayyaprayer.com/version.json once a build is live on the store. Full instructions: CICD.md, 'Announcing a store update'.

notes: Block apps at prayer time: the apps you choose stay closed from the call until you tap I have prayed.
Stop doomscrolling: choose a daily time for an app. When you reach it, Hayya reminds you to put your phone down.
The adhan as your ringtone: in Alarms, set Ringtone to Adhan and your calls ring with the adhan you chose.
A ringtone for each alarm: open one of your alarms and tap Ringtone to give it its own sound.
Alarms as a quiet reminder: an alarm can arrive as one notification at its time, and nothing rings back.
A snooze length for each alarm, from 5 to 30 minutes.
Your companion is now a lantern. Its flame shows how your last seven days of prayer went.
Hayya on Wear OS watches: the next prayer on your watch, a Hayya watch face, and calls that buzz your wrist.
Choose your ringtone from any of your phone's ringtones or alarm sounds, and every call rings with it.
Calls ring at your alarm volume, and you can make them louder in Alarms.
The five built-in ringtones are louder.
Try a call from the themes screen as soon as you pick its theme.
